title: Link and QR code
summary: The person's profile link bipe.chat/@handle and its QR code, to show in person or share. Whoever scans or opens it lands on person-profile in the app, or on the web profile page.

handle.description: Required. Without one the screen opens handle-pick instead.

copyLink.effect: Copies the URL and shows bipe_app_copied.

share.effect: System share sheet with the URL.

showQr.effect: Shows the QR code of the URL full screen with the brightness up while it shows.

scanQr.effect: Opens the camera to scan another person's code. A bipe.chat/@ link opens person-profile; an invite link opens the invite flow; anything else shows bipe_app_people_qr_unknown.

notes: The QR code holds only the public link; it grants nothing. It is not the sign-in QR of another device (security.md rule 5): a scan here never approves a device.
Camera permission is asked only on scanQr (onboarding.md: Permissions).
Bipe logic: BipeProfileLink.url, BipeQRCodeView, BipeProfileQRCodeSheet (iOS); BipeProfileLink.url, BipeQrCodeContent, BipeProfileQrSheet (Android).
